# GH1 Construction

> GH1 Construction is a residential remodeling contractor owned by George Horaites, serving Lake County, Cook County, and the northwest suburbs of the greater Chicagoland area, Illinois. The business is licensed, insured, and built entirely on referrals and word-of-mouth rather than advertising.

## Services
GH1 Construction handles full room renovations and individual trades:
- Kitchen remodeling
- Bathroom remodeling
- Basement finishing
- Porch and deck construction
- Flooring installation and refinishing
- Drywall installation and repair
- Electrical work
- Interior and exterior painting
- Plumbing

## Service area
Lake County, IL; Cook County, IL; and the northwest suburbs of Chicago.

## Contact
- Phone/text: (619) 405-5213
- Email: ghoraites@yahoo.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–7:00 PM
- Free estimates offered on every project
